descriptionChirho: A Hebrew proper noun (אֵלוֹן) referring to several biblical persons: a Hittite father-in-law of Esau, a Zebulunite judge, and a son of Zebulun. Rendered consistently as 'Elon' (eng), 'Elón / Elon' (spa), 'एलोन' (hin), 'إيلونُ' (arb), '엘론' (kor), 'Eloni' (swa). The two clusters differ only in the presence or absence of the conjunction waw (וְ), which is grammatical, not semantic.
